It also edits the approved params file so that the control test still passes. The cited exception EXC-0225 is scoped to `payments.session`, not the `payments.policy` component where the deviation sits, so it doesn't cover the change. Separately, the JUnit report came from a developer workstation a day after the recorded CI run, so it is not valid testing evidence. The change is rejected.
